dct_description_sm:
Notes on OPJU files:

The .opju files in this dataset are Origin/OriginPro project files, created using the OriginLab software for data analysis and graphing. To open and view these files, you can use Origin Viewer, which allows you to explore graphs and data without needing a full Origin license.

Notes on Preservation Files:

For preservation purposes, 'flat file' versions of the multi-spreadsheet Excel workbooks contained in this dataset have been created. The content of these Excel workbooks, have been exported into preservation-friendly format and stored in the Preservation Files zip archive.

This dataset contains all raw and processed experimental data supporting the study titled above, conducted at the Bioproducts Discovery and Development Centre (BDDC), University of Guelph, in 2025.  The data describe the fabrication and characterization of recycled polypropylene (rPP) and recycled linear low-density polyethylene (rLLDPE) composites reinforced with Miscanthus-derived biocarbon.
